children: Thailand’s exports surged 24.3% yoy in August 2026, up from 21.6% in July, marking the fastest increase since January but slightly below the 24.9% forecast. In July, the Commerce Ministry maintained its forecast for export growth of 8% this year, supported by easing global tensions and strong tech demand.

title: Thailand Export Growth Hits 7-Month High
